fields.title: Move budget from three weak prospecting ad sets to retargeting
fields.cause: Holiday auction pushed prospecting CPMs up 28%; three ad sets return under 1.5x and take 41% of spend.
fields.plan: Pause the three ad sets, shift $18k a week to retargeting and the early-access list, re-check return after seven days.

fields.title: Agent drafts the first reply for order-status tickets
fields.cause: Order-status questions are 47% of new tickets and wait behind complex cases.
fields.plan: Let the support agent draft replies from the shipment log for order-status tickets; a person sends them. Target: first reply within two hours.

fields.title: Win-back offer for subscribers who skipped two boxes
fields.cause: Cancellations cluster two to three weeks after the price-change e-mail, mostly among annual-plan renewals.
fields.plan: Offer one free box to 640 subscribers with two skips; call the top 50 by lifetime value.

fields.title: Book follow-up meetings with 15 trade-show buyers
fields.cause: Buyers met at the October show have not been followed up; 22 of 54 deals have no next step.
fields.plan: Send samples to the 15 largest buyers and book a 20-minute call with each before Thanksgiving.

fields.title: Add a second packing shift on Mondays
fields.cause: Weekend orders pile up and Monday packing finishes Tuesday night.
fields.plan: Second shift 2–10 pm on Mondays through December.

fields.title: Reorder the top 10 SKUs two weeks earlier through December
fields.cause: Supplier lead times stretched from 21 to 34 days; reorder points were set for summer.
fields.plan: Raise reorder points on the top 10 SKUs and place December POs this week.
